tagline: About A realtime Chain Reaction game with USDC prize pools,,,
description: onchain chain reaction 🎮 place orbs → cells explode → colors flip → someone cries. winner takes all USDC. real-time PvP on Base .let's get chaotic.Onchain Reaction Chain Reaction… but onchain, realtime, and with USDC stakes. This is a multiplayer Chain Reaction (Orbs) game that runs partly onchain and partly on SpacetimeDB. You place orbs, things explode, players compete, winner takes the USDC pot.
how_its_made: What the App Actually Does ✔ Real-time online matches SpacetimeDB handles turns, animations, eliminations — zero lag. ✔ Onchain USDC stakes Create a match → set entry fee → players deposit → winner claims onchain. ✔ Built on Base Fast, low-cost transactions on Ethereum L2. Uses Base Builder Codes for onchain attribution. ✔ Tokens: USDC & $JESSE Play with stablecoins or meme tokens. ✔ Local multiplayer Old-school: two to five players on the same device. ✔ Clean UI Doodle-style board, smooth orbs, accessible design. ✔ Oracle service A tiny background worker that finalizes SpacetimeDB games on-chain. ✔ Farcaster Native Seamless login with Farcaster (SIWF). Works perfectly as a Frame or Miniapp. 🛠 Tech Stack (as it is, not sugar-coated) Frontend Next.js (App Router) React + Typescript Tailwind Framer Motion Wagmi + Viem + ox Farcaster Miniapp SDK Backend SpacetimeDB (Rust) → realtime game logic Solidity contracts → deposits, payouts, escrow Node oracle → listens to Spacetime
